title: Rational Hodge classes on products of K3 surfaces
exact_target: For any finite nonempty list of projective complex K3 surfaces $S_{1},\dots ,S_m$, does every rational cohomology class of type (p,p) on their product arise as the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle, for each integer $0\leq p\leq 2m$?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For any finite nonempty list of projective complex K3 surfaces $S_{1},\dots ,S_m$, does every rational cohomology class of type (p,p) on their product arise as the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle, for each integer $0\leq p\leq 2m$?

\subsection{Short English statement}
For any finite nonempty list of projective complex K3 surfaces $S_{1},\dots ,S_m$, does every rational cohomology class of type (p,p) on their product arise as the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle, for each integer $0\leq p\leq 2m$?
